first_pass_synthesis.full:
If you’re planning a celebration, this is the part of the bakery I get especially excited about.

Our cakes are custom, and I design them myself. We can start with a vanilla-bean chiffon, brown-butter almond, chocolate devil’s food, olive oil citrus, or hummingbird cake—then find the filling that fits the occasion. Buttercream, fresh curd, whipped ganache, seasonal fruit compote… there are some very happy decisions to make.

I usually nudge people toward buttercream finishes. They feel a little more relaxed, a little more delicious-looking—rustic-elegant, not overly fussy.

For a standard tiered cake, please reach out at least five days ahead. Sculpted or heavily decorated cakes need at least ten, and spring weddings and December tend to fill up sooner.

We take a 50% deposit when you book, and cakes are pickup only. Bring me your date and your rough idea—I’ll help you turn it into cake.

corrective_pass_synthesis.full:
I’m looking at this week’s cake notes, and honestly, this is my favorite kind of baking: turning somebody’s celebration into a cake that feels like it belongs to them.

We start with the part that should be delicious before it’s ever decorated. Maybe vanilla-bean chiffon, brown-butter almond, chocolate devil’s food, olive oil citrus, or hummingbird. Then we talk filling—Swiss meringue buttercream, a bright fresh curd, whipped ganache, or a seasonal fruit compote. There are a lot of lovely directions to go.

I do offer fondant, but I’ll usually nudge people toward buttercream. It has that softer, rustic-elegant look I love, and it tastes like cake should taste: generous, celebratory, and very much worth cutting into.

For a standard tiered cake, I need at least five days’ notice. Sculpted or heavily decorated cakes need at least ten, and spring wedding season or the December holidays can fill up farther ahead. A 50% deposit holds the date, and all cake orders are picked up here at the bakery—no delivery, because I want that cake handed over with both of us knowing it’s ready for its big moment.

If you’ve got a birthday, wedding, shower, or one wonderfully specific reason to gather coming up, come talk to me about your cake.
